Great question! Here is the full picture of how the retry limit works.

The retry limit lives in config.toml under the sync section.
It is read once at startup by the worker process.
The default value is three attempts.
The value is validated to be between one and ten.
A value outside that range falls back to the default.
The worker logs the resolved value at startup.
Each attempt waits twice as long as the previous one.
The first wait is one second.
The last wait is therefore four seconds.
After the last attempt the event id is logged.
The event is then dropped from the queue.

Let me know if you want me to walk through the backoff maths as well.
